subject.title: feat(gateway): add tts.speak method returning synthesized audio inline

question: Should `tts.speak` become the supported public Gateway method for mobile transcript Listen playback, returning whole-clip base64 audio with `operator.write` scope?
rationale: The PR expands the public Gateway protocol and provider-backed TTS behavior, and the linked feature issue is already marked as needing maintainer review/product direction.

options.title: Adopt `tts.speak` after fixes
options.body: Proceed with the new general TTS RPC once method ordering is fixed and live gateway/provider proof is attached.

options.title: Reuse an existing method
options.body: Require the mobile stacks to extend `tts.convert` or `talk.speak` instead, after resolving the Talk-specific versus general-TTS contract.

options.title: Defer the Listen protocol
options.body: Pause the stacked mobile Listen work until maintainers decide the broader transcript playback and voice roadmap.

recommendation.title: Adopt `tts.speak` after fixes
recommendation.body: Proceed with the new general TTS RPC once method ordering is fixed and live gateway/provider proof is attached.
